continuity_scope: Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition product witness: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, official D&D Beyond product page published 16 August 2022. The declared product bundle includes Astral Adventurer's Guide, Boo's Astral Menagerie, and Light of Xaryxis, but this audit uses only the visible setting/rules headings. Older Spelljammer editions, novels, games, and home campaigns are excluded.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Official D&D Beyond Fifth Edition source page, published 16 August 2022.
Component of the declared 2022 product bundle; official D&D Beyond source page.
Official D&D Beyond errata page, current/recent-printing updates.

coverage_rule: Terms-only audit. The accessible official pages establish the exact 5e product, its three-book bundle structure, setting concepts, and rule headings, but do not expose enough claim-level prose for a fixed named dramatic cohort. No character or relationship records are made from an index or adventure heading. Ships, ancestries, classes, factions, monsters, items, Wildspace/Astral concepts, places, rules, and player characters remain terms/dimensions.
omissions: All indexed Light of Xaryxis NPCs, adventure outcomes, and table-created player characters, which need licensed claim-level text and a distinct narrative-outcome policy.
All older Spelljammer editions, novels, games, comics, adaptations, and home-campaign continuity.
Ships, ancestry categories, generic monsters, items, locations, factions, planes, and core-D&D rules as character nodes.
Detailed ancestry/representation claims—including Hadozee material—beyond the dated official errata record used only to document product revision.
uncertainties: The source pages are official contents/index and rule-heading witnesses, not full licensed setting/adventure text; individual profile claims are intentionally absent.
Official errata makes clear that recent printings and D&D Beyond text changed. This pass does not harmonize pre-errata text, later redesign, or other editions.

The adventure/setting can involve peril, invasion, combat, falling/crashing, and space survival; records remain non-graphic. Table-specific safety and content boundaries remain a DM/player responsibility.
evidence_basis: Official D&D Beyond identifies the 2022 5e product and its Astral Adventurer's Guide concepts. Official errata records textual/rules revisions, including ancestry-option changes. No wiki, fan material, or cross-edition source is used.

citations.locator: Source landing page, publication date, and Astral Adventurer's Guide Contents
supports: 2022 5e product identity and terms Wildspace, Astral Sea/Plane, air envelopes, gravity planes, spelljamming ships, and helms.
